FOMC interest rate decision will happen today at 2PM ET.

91% odds of a rate pause, so it has pretty much priced in.

At 2:30PM ET, Kevin Warsh's press conference will start, which is the most important one.

Since the last FOMC meeting, both CPI and PPI have spiked higher, which means the inflation problem is getting worse.

If Warsh hints at more future rate hikes, markets could selloff hard.

And if he hints at a rate pause, BTC could tap the $82K-$82.5K zone.

tweets.text:
$BTC Starting to move higher as shorts are closing out or getting squeezed.

Like I said, a lot of derisking and uncertainty has happened already into this week. If nothing happens then the base case is a grind higher I think.

But we're yet yet to see a lot of events unfold. FOMC today, tech earnings still ongoing with the biggest names yet to come.

And of course midterms next week too.

But in all this chaos and uncertainty, let the chart lead. It often tells more than any headline would ever do.

quote.text:
$BTC Another day sitting at the $80K support.

Neither bull or bear seems to be able to get this market moving in any direction at this point.

I do stand by my point of yesterday. Even in a non ideal outcome of all the upcoming events, once they are done with, the market has certainty which helps the bulls more than the bears.

So if the bears want to see lower levels, it should happen sooner than later for that scenario to play out in my opinion.

The more selling gets absorbed down here during all this uncertainty without a breakdown, the more likely it is that we'll see seller exhaustion at some point and the market just starts grinding higher.

tweets.text:
Today’s decision may be less important than the message that comes with it.

I don’t expect the Fed to change rates today. What matters more is whether policymakers leave the door open for another hike before the end of the year.

There’s a good reason to expect that.

Inflation is still proving stubborn. Demand remains fairly strong, while supply-side pressures are adding to the problem. At the same time, the labor market is starting to weaken, even if that isn’t fully showing up in the headline data yet.

That puts the Fed in a difficult position. Cutting too soon could reignite inflation, but keeping rates high for too long could put more pressure on the labor market.

For now, I think the Fed will prioritize inflation.

So while today may be a pause, I don’t think the tightening story is necessarily over. I’d expect the Fed to keep a December hike firmly on the table.

91% odds of a rate pause, so it has pretty much priced in.

If Warsh hints at more future rate hikes, markets could selloff hard.

And if he hints at a rate pause, BTC could tap the $82K-$82.5K zone.

tweets.text:
For the record: We're not Shaw and never claimed to be.

We follow him because http://github.com/lalalune/daosfun-source is where OpenPump started. That repo shows a closed Solana program can be pulled from the chain and reconstructed into source. We used that tooling and approach on the pumpfun programs to understand exactly how they behave.

Then we did something different: we didn’t reconstruct pumpfun, we rewrote it. Zero bytes copied, our own seeds, layouts and fee math, and a parity doc that says where we match and where we don’t.

The goal was never a 1:1 clone. It’s a more decentralized, open-source launchpad: an open AMM anyone can create pools on, parameters readable on-chain, upgrade keys in a multisig, everything on GitHub.

http://github.com/openpumptrade/openpump

tweets.text:
The Total Altcoin Market Cap has come down to retest its previous support/resistance level and Weekly 200MA/EMA.

This is technically still a solid region for a higher low to be created. This upcoming week of events will likely show the direction from here on out.

Set a higher low here and we can start targeting the dead cat bounce high at the start of 2026 as a next high timeframe target.

If this level is lost it is easy to see this trade down an additional ~10% until the next support area.

But support is support until it isn't.
